settings.text: Use only the instructions supplied with your approved product. This sequence is a high-level guide, not a substitute for the manual.
Adults aged 18 years and over only
Competent swimmers with another responsible adult present
Never use while impaired or near drains, covers, ropes or loose equipment
Switch powered products off before handling and charge only when fully dry

settings.heading: Relaxed pool time starts with clear limits.
settings.text: Docked aquatic products are for competent adult swimmers in calm, controlled swimming pools. They are not life-saving devices or personal flotation devices.

settings.question: When will Docked products be available?
settings.answer: Products remain Draft until supplier, safety, compliance, pricing, imagery, shipping and payment checks are complete. The current site is a prelaunch preview and does not accept orders.

settings.question: Are Docked aquatic products adults-only?
settings.answer: Yes. Docked markets every aquatic product for adults aged 18 years and over. This does not replace supervision, swimming ability, product testing or any applicable Australian product-safety obligation.

settings.question: Can I use a Docked float at the beach or on a river?
settings.answer: No. Unless a particular product is separately approved and documented, Docked aquatic products are for calm, controlled swimming pools only—not oceans, rivers, lakes, moving water, waves or currents.

settings.question: Is a Docked float a life-saving device?
settings.answer: No. A pool float is not a life-saving device or personal flotation device and must never be relied on to prevent drowning.
